item.title: From Seconds of Visual Impact to Minutes of Storytelling: AI Video Is Moving Toward Narrative Depth
item.summary: As AI video generation moves from short, fast-paced imagery toward more developed storytelling, creators increasingly need tools that can support multi-scene narratives, consistent characters, and structured workflows. Tools such as CapCut Video Studio Director Mode are being developed to help creators manage these elements within a shared creative environment. These tools are not a replacement […]
